Strict Rules & Architecture **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** - All styling lives in a dedicated `style.css`. The `style="…"` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. - All design properties, layout rules, and states are applied exclusively via class or ID selectors. - HTML stays semantic and style-agnostic (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `article`, `footer`); retheming the site must require editing only `style.css`. **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** - Every token in the table above is defined in `:root` (Light) and overridden for Dark per Section 1.3. - Set `color-scheme: light` on the base theme and `color-scheme: dark` on the dark theme so native controls and scrollbars follow. - Never hard-code hex values in component rules — components consume tokens via `var(…)` only. **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support** - Define dark tokens under a `.dark` class on `` **and** duplicate them under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` (guarded so it only applies when no explicit class is set) so the page works correctly both with and without JS. - Provide a visible theme toggle button in the header: swaps the Material Symbol (`light_mode` / `dark_mode`), exposes `aria-pressed` reflecting the current theme, and has a descriptive `aria-label` (e.g., “Toggle dark mode”). - Persistence order: saved `localStorage` preference → `prefers-color-scheme` → Light. Apply the resolved class before first paint to prevent a flash of the wrong theme. - *Exception clause (source spec marks “✓ Light / ○ Dark”):* Light is the base/default theme — the `:root` tokens are the Light palette — while Dark Mode remains fully implemented and toggleable per this section. **1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment** - Build every layout structure with Flexbox (`display: flex` / Tailwind flex utilities). **Do not use CSS Grid.** Card rows use `flex-wrap` with `flex-basis` (e.g., `flex: 1 1 300px`) so they collapse to single columns naturally. - Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an explicitly justified exception is documented in a CSS comment. - Mobile-first: no horizontal scrolling at any viewport width down to 320px; rows convert to columns on small viewports; fluid type and spacing via `clamp()` where appropriate. **1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration** - Load Tailwind CSS via CDN.
